description: Text that no input token covers, between two adjacent opaque parts, belongs to the first of them: `a,b` gives `a,` and `b`. Each part sounds `?` and has its text as its label (engine §5, §11).

documents.g.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text [{part}]
%rule part letter | comma
%rule letter "a" | "b" %emits $ :: L

%rule comma ","
```
documents.h.md:
```jbogenbau
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text ($a:v $b:v) %emits $a :: A, $b :: B

%rule v :- $.verbatim-text | L

```
